text:
maria: Heads up — RMA created for replacements we just received. Vendor shipped 40 units claiming H100s but 30 are tagged as 80GB A100 legacy SKU. RMA-98321. 
ops-bot: automated: RMA 98321 opened; severity: high; assigned: logistics@redwood.
vendor_john: Really sorry — fulfillment mix during split-pallet staging. We can prioritize a corrective shipment. Initial ETA for correct H100s from our pool is 6–8 weeks. 
liam: 6–8 weeks will create a capacity gap in us-west-2 next week. How many H100s can you air-expedite now? 
jess: Also need serials + photos for the DOA/mismatch claim to process customs return. 
vendor_john: We can air 10 H100s out within 4 business days if you cover expedited freight (+$900/unit) or we can absorb half freight if you accept $2k/unit credit on the remaining 30. Photos and serials needed to confirm. 
maria: Tradeoff: pay freight to get 10 quickly vs accept credit and wait. We have a canary service that needs ~12 H100s. We can repurpose 12 staging GPUs but then infra loses warm spares. 
evangelion: (evan) we’ll run into queue throttling if we lose spares. Forecast: projected 48-hour burn will exceed available H100s by Monday EOD unless we get at least 8 H100s air. Can we negotiate 8 air units with vendor covering customs/detention? 
vendor_john: I can do 8 air units with vendor covering customs/detention fees, but we need formal acceptance to invoice freight adjustments. For the 30 mismatched A100s we propose a credit of $2k/unit and exchange RMA return when the H100s arrive. 
liam: If vendor covers detention, that helps. What about swapping allocations from our APAC reserved pool temporarily? Any procurement admin to flip 10 units from apac to us-west? 
jess: APAC has a soft buffer of 6 H100s. Ops policy requires written approval from finance for cross-region swaps >6 units. 
maria: Request: vendor_john — send a written trade proposal: 8 air H100s vendor covers customs/detention; remaining 32 (22 H100s + 10 A100s?) — we need clear SKUs. Need serials for the 30 A100s and a return label AWB for the staged returns. 
vendor_john: Sending formal quote now. Draft: ship 8 H100 air (no customs/detention to Redwood), credit $2k/unit on the 30 A100s, exchange remaining 22 H100s in 6–8 weeks. Will provide return AWBs for A100s. 
logistics-bot: new_awbs: ["1Z999AA10123456784", "1Z999AA10123456785"] assigned to warehouse FRA-33. Hold flag: customs_doc_required.
jess: Please attach proforma invoice for customs — need HS code 8471.80 and value breakdown. Last time customs held a pallet due to missing CN22. 
vendor_john: Will attach proforma. Also need the firmware mismatch note from your side — some A100s are showing older firmware which we need logged to accept the exchange. 
maria: We'll pull serials + firmware batch from staging. Quick command for inventory pull: 
```
inv-cli get-by-batch --batch RPL-447 --fields serial,sku,firmware
```
liam: If vendor insists on $900/unit freight and we decline, option B: accept credit and rotate some models to maintain capacity (downgrade heavy jobs to A100-friendly configs). Cost estimate: extra runtime + dev time ~ $18k/week. Finance sign-off needed. 
evangelion: Can we borrow Dedicated buffer pool? That's the cheaper stopgap than air freight. How many buffers free? 
maria: Buffer pool currently has 9 free H100s in staging + 3 in eu-west reserve. We can move 6 from eu-west but that takes 48h transit. 
jess: For the returns: customs in FRA are likely to flag mixed commercial invoices. Vendor must include explicit return reason codes. If vendor covers the return courier cost, make sure the AWB includes "RMA RETURN" on CN23 form. 
vendor_john: Understood. I'll mark AWBs as RMA RETURN, attach CN23/proforma, and include photos. Sending follow-up email with proposal and proforma in next 30m. 
ops-bot: incident-note: provisioning-impact: service-team-canary at 2026-03-23 03:00 UTC may see throttling if air shipment isn't accepted. Suggested actions: accept 8-air or authorize cross-region swap request. 
maria: I'll escalate to finance for one-time expedite approval for 8 H100s covered by vendor on customs/detention. Also request vendor credit note PDF for the 30 A100s so accounting can pre-authorize. 
liam: If we get the 8 H100s air, plan: allocate 6 to canary, 2 to warm spares. If vendor credit arrives, we will schedule returns next week via FRA-33 dock. 
jess: One more ask — vendor, please include a packing manifest with exact pallet weights and HS codes; customs wants gross weight per pallet. 
vendor_john: Will include. Also offering a 3-month extension on warranty for the swapped units as goodwill. 
maria: Thanks. Once quote lands, I'll post final decision here. :thumbsup:
